criteria.text: Sync previews unique exact or near copy replacements without writing files.
Sync with --write adopts the selected shared schema and preserves local title and description.
Ambiguous copies stay unchanged while independent unambiguous copies can migrate.
Editing an approved interface sets it to draft without approving it.
Unrelated source stays exact, and a repeated sync makes no further changes.
Sync refuses an unsafe destination or concurrent source edit without overwriting it.

cases.given: one equal copy, one unique near copy; capture source bytes before command
cases.required_observation: proposals show target, pointer, missing/changed constraints; bytes remain identical

cases.given: copy has title CLI request, description local, lacks run_id; shared schema requires run_id
cases.required_observation: write reference with both annotations; expanded schema now requires run_id; no silently retained local constraint

cases.given: one copy has two near records; separate copy has unique exact record
cases.required_observation: ambiguous copy unchanged and warns; unique copy migrates
status draft; never approved; prose, hash string and approval state otherwise unchanged

cases.given: unmatched prompt, prose before/after interface, original scenario; apply sync twice
cases.required_observation: unrelated bytes exact; second run writes 0 files

cases.given: symlink ancestor, secret destination and changed before bytes in separate cases
cases.required_observation: refuse unsafe/changed file; no overwrite, upload, authentication or model call
